relation_to_iso_31000.how_related: The text never prints the string «ISO 31000» (checked on all 51 pages). The relation is expressed only through the national standard: INSO 13245:1398 «مدیریت ریسک - رهنمودها» (clause 2-1), which the introduction (مقدمه, PDF 8) says this standard is designed to be used together with. Clauses 4, 5 and 6 repeatedly defer to the matching sub-clause of «استاندارد ملی ایران شمارهٔ ۱۳۲۴۵: سال ۱۳۹۸». INSO 13246:1389 «مدیریت ریسک - واژگان» is the vocabulary reference (clause 2-2).
relation_to_iso_31000.note: That 13245:1398 corresponds to ISO 31000:2018 and 13246:1389 to ISO Guide 73:2009 is NOT stated in this PDF; do not cite it as printed evidence from this document.

notes: Cover (PDF 1) is bilingual: Persian side «استاندارد ملی ایران ۲۳۷۳۳ / چاپ اول / ۱۴۰۳»; English side «INSO 23733 / 1st Edition / 2024 / Identical with ISO/IEC 23894:2023».
Expected by the owner: INSO 23733 (1403), basis ISO/IEC 23894:2023 - CONFIRMED on the pages; no difference found.

Risk vocabulary: title uses «مخاطره (ریسک)»; running text uses «مخاطره» almost everywhere; PDF 8 footnote 1 prints «Risk» and states that INSO 13246:1389 and INSO 13245:1398 use the Persian word «ریسک». Their titles (clause 2) indeed print «ریسک».

Printed clause numbers are Persian digits joined by hyphen (e.g. «۲-۵»); read right-to-left they are major-minor (5-2 = clause 5.2). Annex clauses use «الف-۱», «ب-۱». outline.json normalises to dotted Latin form and keeps the printed form in number_printed.
No figures are printed in the document; 5 tables (Tables 1-4 and Table پ-1).
Clause 3 defines nothing itself: it only points to INSO 13245:1398, INSO 23679:1403 and INSO 13246:1389 (see terms.json).
Publisher address block (PDF 2) lists Tehran and Karaj offices, website https://www.inso.gov.ir/ and mail portal https://mail.inso.gov.ir/ as printed.
uncertainties: Cross-reference [8] in A.11 prints «استاندارد ملی ایران شماره ۲۷۰۱۳»; the bibliography entry [8] is ISO/IEC 27005:2022 with a note naming INSO ISO/IEC 27005:1392 (see uncertainties.md U1).
The national numbers of the three normative references are printed, their ISO equivalents are not.
